t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Pick the gnome which gives out the most mushrooms in each colour combination.  You always get the same colour combinations.

vb_textbox.text: Use the times when the score is on a 1x multipler to try and work out which of the gnomes will collect more mushrooms and make your best guesses when it is on the 5x multiplier.  There are only a small number of the same colour combination gnomes so you can work out the pattern quite quickly.  Whether or not one colour gnome will get more than the other colour in that particular pairing doesn't seem to change.  You can get between 0 and 9 mushrooms.
